mapping.summary: Hotel operations platform on LS Central
claims: Room reservations, guest details, sales, service bookings and inventory in one database
Manages rooms, appointments, restaurant reservations, activities and rentals
Handles booking changes and cancellations automatically
Assigns staff, rooms and equipment automatically by availability to avoid overbooking
Dynamic room rates driven by occupancy and demand, with optional revenue management integration
Check-in and check-out at the front desk, on mobile devices or via self-service kiosks
Certified OTA/channel manager connections with SynXis, SiteMinder and Channex
Group bookings, discounts and additional charges
Prepayments, deposits and charge-to-room from any outlet
Modules include PMS, rate and channel management, folio invoicing, housekeeping, eCommerce, loyalty, self-checkout
